findings.passage: “When you go through the voter rolls and you find a non-U.S. citizen, does the secretary of state have any power to turn that over to authorities?”
findings.note: Question put by this senator to the bill's author on the Senate floor during debate of the SHIELD Act (SB 2588), about whether the Secretary of State can refer non-citizens found on voter rolls to authorities. Quoted by the Mississippi Free Press, article dated 2026-03-25; the floor date is Feb. 5, 2026. A question, not a stated position.
